title: Tenma Tsukasa — In Tearful Eyes, An Immortal Bird〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: In Tearful Eyes, An Immortal Bird（4★）
meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Another day, another failed attempt at grasping my character during practice...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I'm beginning to understand how hard it is to get by on just water. So, I just need to keep doing what I can to understand Rio better.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm already home.
Time flies when you mull things over, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't let Saki see the downcast expression that's on my face right now...)
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...!
This smell...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Tsukasa♪
Guess what? We're having curry for dinner tonight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I knew it...! But...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! Did you forget that I'd be eating out today...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You said you guys would all go out for food after practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, how was practice?
Do you think you're gonna get to play the boy for “The Happy Phoenix”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Oh... I shouldn't deceive her too much...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I'm still not sure...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because I'm competing against all these great actors from the park's number one stage! And on top of that, it's a fairly tricky role!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. You say that, but your face is telling me that you feel pretty good about this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Hah hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No! I revealed too much of the truth...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I believe in you, Tsukasa!
I'm sure you'll do just fine♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki! I appreciate it!
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My stomach won't stop grumbling...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But Rio also experienced this pain.
I can't let myself forget that...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Excuse me...
Is Tsukasa here right now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, Toya.
I'm right here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing that important...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But the actor you told me about will be performing on stage soon, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you talking about Mr. Amami's show...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As much as I want to go see him, I need to keep practicing for my audition...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya...?
You've been staring at my face this entire time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya...
Is there something else that you'd like to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've known each other for how long? Please, don't hesitate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The thing is, just yesterday, I messaged Saki to see if she would take one of my claw machine prize plushies...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was when she mentioned you were acting a bit different.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That's why you're here right now. To make sure I'm doing okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm sorry...
I know I'm being very nosy, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (All this lying and deception is definitely starting to confuse everyone, including myself...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I apologize, Toya.
I've actually been practicing for a role in this very big show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm struggling to get a grasp of my character. Saki may've felt something was off because I had so much on my mind when I discussed this with her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right, she also mentioned that you've been practicing for a big show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be sure to tell her that there's no need to worry. And thank you for showing so much concern.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I understand. It sounds like a tough role, but you also put on an incredible performance as Thorpe that other time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I'm sure you'll do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I believe in you, Tsukasa!
I'm sure you'll do just fine♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I promise to do my best and not disappoint any of you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, I should send Saki a message.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They believe in me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They're all giving me their support.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still have a few days left until the audition. They've placed their faith in me, so I need to figure out how to play Rio!)
